description.value: Fernie Slopeside Lodge sits at the base of Fernie Alpine Resort, offering true ski-in access just a two-minute walk from the lifts and one minute from the resort plaza. Accommodation ranges from cozy Standard Rooms with kitchenettes to a full Alpine Suite sleeping up to 10, catering to groups and families. Located 5 km from the town of Fernie, it serves as a practical base for exploring the Elk Valley in both winter and summer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The amenities page confirms free guest laundry, complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site vending machines, and that ski/snowboard gear may be brought to rooms with a gear stand at the front door for quick drop-off — but no bicycle-specific storage or bike handling procedure is mentioned anywhere on the site. Nearby dining and an adjacent grocery/liquor store (Mountain Pantry) are explicitly confirmed by the front page and amenities page.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly bookable hotel with an active website and reservation system; useful to touring cyclists as a base for riding in the Elk Valley near Fernie.
enrichment_extras.notes: The nearby Fernie Alpine Resort rental shop offers fat bikes according to the website, indicating cycling activity in the area, but the lodge itself documents no cyclist-specific services.

Laundry.detail: Free guest laundry listed under Comfort & Convenience on the amenities page

Nearby evening food.detail: Griz Bar, Cirque Restaurant, Legends Restaurant, and the Slopeside Deli are all within the resort plaza, described as a one-minute walk from the lodge

Nearby grocery.detail: Mountain Pantry & Liquor Store is located next door to the lodge, carrying groceries, snacks, beer, wine, spirits, and a Starbucks coffee bar

Vending machines.detail: Vending machines available on site, listed under Common Spaces on the amenities page
